question_en: Which statements are true? 1) $1\ \mathrm{Wb}=1\ \mathrm{T\cdot m^2}$; 2) the induced emf is proportional to the magnitude of the magnetic flux; 3) the induced current opposes the change of the flux that produced it; 4) in a rotating frame the emf is largest when the flux is largest; 5) inductance does not depend on the current.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) $1\ \mathrm{Wb}=1\ \mathrm{T\cdot m^2}$; 2) induksiya EYK oqim kattaligiga proporsional; 3) induksion tok o'zini hosil qilgan oqim o'zgarishiga qarshi; 4) aylanayotgan ramkada EYK oqim eng katta paytda eng katta; 5) induktivlik tok kuchiga bog'liq emas.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) $1\ \mathrm{Wb}=1\ \mathrm{T\cdot m^2}$; 2) ЭДС индукции пропорциональна величине магнитного потока; 3) индукционный ток противодействует изменению вызвавшего его потока; 4) во вращающейся рамке ЭДС максимальна, когда поток максимален; 5) индуктивность не зависит от силы тока.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. EYK oqimning o'zgarish tezligiga bog'liq (2 noto'g'ri); oqim eng katta bo'lganda u o'zgarmaydi, EYK = 0 (4 noto'g'ri).
Asos: Faradey qonuni, Lens qoidasi.

uz: 2 va 4 — noto'g'ri, chunki EYK $\Phi$ ga emas: $$\mathcal{E}_i=-\Phi'(t),\qquad \Phi_{max}\ \Rightarrow\ \mathcal{E}_i=0$$
ru: 2 и 4 неверны, так как ЭДС зависит не от $\Phi$: $$\mathcal{E}_i=-\Phi'(t),\qquad \Phi_{max}\ \Rightarrow\ \mathcal{E}_i=0$$
en: 2 and 4 are false, since the emf depends not on $\Phi$: $$\mathcal{E}_i=-\Phi'(t),\qquad \Phi_{max}\ \Rightarrow\ \mathcal{E}_i=0$$

distractors.D: EYK oqimning o'ziga proporsional deb olingan
distractors.E: EYK oqim eng katta paytda eng katta deb olingan

distractors_ru.D: принято, что ЭДС пропорциональна самому потоку
distractors_ru.E: принято, что ЭДС максимальна при максимальном потоке

distractors_en.A: statement 5 (inductance depends on geometry) was missed
distractors_en.D: the emf was taken as proportional to the flux itself
distractors_en.E: the emf was taken as largest when the flux is largest

question_en: Which of the following units equals a volt?
question_uz: Quyidagi birliklardan qaysi biri voltga teng?
question_ru: Какая из следующих единиц равна вольту?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Faradey qonunidan ℰ = ΔΦ/Δt, demak 1 V = 1 Wb/s. T·m² — veber, H/A va H·s — boshqa birliklar.
Asos: Faradey qonuni.

distractors.D: bu birlik Wb·s/A ga teng, volt emas
distractors.E: bu birlik Wb/A² ga teng, volt emas

distractors_ru.A: поток умножен на время вместо деления
distractors_ru.D: эта единица равна Wb·s/A, а не вольту
distractors_ru.E: эта единица равна Wb/A², а не вольту

distractors_en.A: the flux was multiplied by time instead of divided
distractors_en.B: this is the unit of magnetic flux, the weber
distractors_en.D: this unit equals Wb·s/A, not a volt
distractors_en.E: this unit equals Wb/A², not a volt

question_en: A ring of diameter $20\ \mathrm{cm}$ is in a uniform field of induction $0.6\ \mathrm{T}$; $\vec B$ makes an angle of $60^\circ$ with the normal to the ring. Find the magnetic flux through the ring ($\mathrm{mWb}$; $\pi=3.14$).
question_uz: Diametri $20\ \mathrm{cm}$ bo'lgan halqa induksiyasi $0.6\ \mathrm{T}$ bo'lgan bir jinsli maydonda turibdi; $\vec B$ halqa normali bilan $60^\circ$ burchak hosil qiladi. Halqa orqali magnit oqimini toping ($\mathrm{mWb}$; $\pi=3.14$).
question_ru: Кольцо диаметром $20\ \mathrm{cm}$ находится в однородном поле с индукцией $0.6\ \mathrm{T}$; $\vec B$ составляет с нормалью к кольцу угол $60^\circ$. Найдите магнитный поток через кольцо ($\mathrm{mWb}$; $\pi=3.14$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. r = 10 cm, S = πr² = 0,0314 m²; Φ = BS·cos60° = 0,6·0,0314·0,5 = 9,42 mWb.
Asos: Φ = BS·cosα.

distractors_en.B: cos60° was not taken into account
distractors_en.C: the sine was used instead of the cosine
distractors_en.D: the diameter was taken as the radius

question_en: The flux through each turn of a solenoid of $120$ turns increased uniformly from $3\ \mathrm{mWb}$ to $9\ \mathrm{mWb}$ in $4\ \mathrm{ms}$. Find the induced emf in the solenoid ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: $120$ o'ramli solenoidning har bir o'rami orqali oqim $4\ \mathrm{ms}$ da $3\ \mathrm{mWb}$ dan $9\ \mathrm{mWb}$ gacha tekis ortdi. Solenoidda hosil bo'lgan induksiya EYK ni toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: Поток через каждый виток соленоида из $120$ витков равномерно возрос с $3\ \mathrm{mWb}$ до $9\ \mathrm{mWb}$ за $4\ \mathrm{ms}$. Найдите ЭДС индукции в соленоиде ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. ℰ = NΔΦ/Δt = 120·6·10⁻³/(4·10⁻³) = 180 V.
Asos: Faradey qonuni (N o'ram).

distractors.B: oqim o'zgarishi o'rniga oxirgi oqim olingan
distractors.C: oqim o'zgarishi o'rniga boshlang'ich oqim olingan

distractors_ru.B: вместо изменения потока взят конечный поток
distractors_ru.C: вместо изменения потока взят начальный поток

distractors_en.A: the number of turns was not taken into account
distractors_en.B: the final flux was used instead of the change
distractors_en.C: the initial flux was used instead of the change
distractors_en.E: the fluxes were added instead of subtracted

question_en: The magnetic flux through a wire frame of resistance $0.4\ \Omega$ changed uniformly from $5\ \mathrm{Wb}$ to $-3\ \mathrm{Wb}$ in $4\ \mathrm{s}$. Find the induced current in the frame ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_uz: Qarshiligi $0.4\ \Omega$ bo'lgan simdan yasalgan ramka orqali magnit oqimi $4\ \mathrm{s}$ da $5\ \mathrm{Wb}$ dan $-3\ \mathrm{Wb}$ gacha tekis o'zgardi. Ramkadagi induksion tokni toping ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_ru: Магнитный поток через рамку из провода сопротивлением $0.4\ \Omega$ равномерно изменился с $5\ \mathrm{Wb}$ до $-3\ \mathrm{Wb}$ за $4\ \mathrm{s}$. Найдите индукционный ток в рамке ($\mathrm{A}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. |ΔΦ| = 5 − (−3) = 8 Wb, ℰ = 8/4 = 2 V, I = 2/0,4 = 5 A.
Asos: Faradey qonuni, Om qonuni.

distractors.A: manfiy ishora e'tiborga olinmagan: ΔΦ = 2 Wb

distractors_ru.A: не учтён знак минус: ΔΦ = 2 Wb
distractors_ru.B: ЭДС умножена на сопротивление вместо деления

distractors_en.A: the minus sign was ignored: ΔΦ = 2 Wb
distractors_en.B: the emf was multiplied by the resistance instead of divided
distractors_en.C: the emf was found, not the current
distractors_en.D: the initial flux was divided by the resistance

question_en: The figure shows the graph of the magnetic flux through a closed circuit versus time. In which time interval ($\mathrm{s}$) is the magnitude of the induced emf largest?
question_uz: Rasmda berk kontur orqali o'tuvchi magnit oqimining vaqtga bog'lanish grafigi berilgan. Qaysi vaqt oralig'ida ($\mathrm{s}$) induksiya EYK ning moduli eng katta?
question_ru: На рисунке дан график зависимости магнитного потока через замкнутый контур от времени. В каком интервале времени ($\mathrm{s}$) модуль ЭДС индукции наибольший?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. |ℰ| — grafik qiyaligi: 4–5 s da oqim 1 s da 6 mWb ga o'zgaradi (6 mV), 0–2 s da 2 mV, 8–10 s da 1 mV, gorizontal qismlarda 0.
Asos: ℰ = −Φ′(t).

rules.en: The emf is the slope of the $\Phi(t)$ graph

distractors.A: oqim ortayotgan oraliq tanlangan, qiyalik solishtirilmagan
distractors.C: oqim eng katta bo'lgan oraliq tanlangan — u yerda EYK nol
distractors.D: oqim moduli katta bo'lgan oraliq tanlangan — EYK nol
distractors.E: eng uzun o'zgarish oralig'i tanlangan — qiyalik eng kichik

distractors_ru.A: выбран участок роста потока, наклоны не сравнивались
distractors_ru.C: выбран участок наибольшего потока — там ЭДС равна нулю
distractors_ru.D: выбран участок с большим модулем потока — ЭДС равна нулю
distractors_ru.E: выбран самый длинный участок изменения — наклон наименьший

distractors_en.A: the interval where the flux grows was chosen without comparing slopes
distractors_en.C: the interval of largest flux was chosen — the emf is zero there
distractors_en.D: an interval of large flux magnitude was chosen — the emf is zero
distractors_en.E: the longest interval of change was chosen — its slope is smallest

question_en: The magnet in the figure faces a fixed metal ring with its south pole and is being moved away from it. Seen from the magnet side: 1) the ring is repelled, current clockwise; 2) repelled, counterclockwise; 3) attracted, counterclockwise; 4) attracted, clockwise; 5) no current.
question_uz: Rasmdagi magnit janubiy qutbi bilan qo'zg'almas metall halqaga qaragan va undan uzoqlashtirilmoqda. Magnit tomondan qaraganda: 1) halqa itariladi, tok soat mili bo'ylab; 2) itariladi, soat miliga teskari; 3) tortiladi, soat miliga teskari; 4) tortiladi, soat mili bo'ylab; 5) tok yo'q.
question_ru: Магнит на рисунке обращён южным полюсом к неподвижному металлическому кольцу и удаляется от него. Если смотреть со стороны магнита: 1) кольцо отталкивается, ток по часовой стрелке; 2) отталкивается, против часовой; 3) притягивается, против часовой; 4) притягивается, по часовой; 5) тока нет.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. S qutbga kiruvchi maydon halqada magnit tomon yo'nalgan va kamaymoqda; induksion maydon ham magnit tomon — tok soat miliga teskari, halqa tortiladi.
Asos: Lens qoidasi.

uz: Oqim kamayadi — $\vec B_i$ eski maydon bo'ylab: $$\Delta|\Phi|<0\ \Rightarrow\ I\ \circlearrowleft$$
ru: Поток убывает — $\vec B_i$ вдоль прежнего поля: $$\Delta|\Phi|<0\ \Rightarrow\ I\ \circlearrowleft$$
en: The flux decreases — $\vec B_i$ along the old field: $$\Delta|\Phi|<0\ \Rightarrow\ I\ \circlearrowleft$$
The ring's face is $N$, the magnet's pole is $S$: attraction

rules.uz: Lens qoidasi: $\vec B_i$ oqim o'zgarishiga qarshi
rules.ru: Правило Ленца: $\vec B_i$ против изменения потока
rules.en: Lenz's law: $\vec B_i$ opposes the change of flux

distractors.A: ham tok, ham kuch yo'nalishi teskari olingan (yaqinlashish holati)
distractors.D: tok yo'nalishi parma qoidasiga teskari aniqlangan

distractors_ru.A: и ток, и сила взяты обратными (случай приближения)
distractors_ru.D: направление тока найдено обратно правилу буравчика
distractors_ru.E: принято, что при удалении поток не меняется

distractors_en.A: both the current and the force were reversed (the approaching case)
distractors_en.B: the force was taken as in the approaching case
distractors_en.D: the current direction was found opposite to the corkscrew rule
distractors_en.E: it was assumed that the flux does not change when moving away

question_en: A conductor of length $0.5\ \mathrm{m}$ moves in a field of induction $0.6\ \mathrm{T}$ perpendicular to itself with a speed of $4\ \mathrm{m/s}$; the conductor is perpendicular to $\vec B$, and the velocity makes an angle of $30^\circ$ with $\vec B$. Find the induced emf ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Uzunligi $0.5\ \mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan o'tkazgich induksiyasi $0.6\ \mathrm{T}$ bo'lgan maydonda o'ziga tik yo'nalishda $4\ \mathrm{m/s}$ tezlik bilan harakatlanmoqda; o'tkazgich $\vec B$ ga tik, tezlik $\vec B$ bilan $30^\circ$ burchak hosil qiladi. Induksiya EYK ni toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: Проводник длиной $0.5\ \mathrm{m}$ движется в поле с индукцией $0.6\ \mathrm{T}$ перпендикулярно себе со скоростью $4\ \mathrm{m/s}$; проводник перпендикулярен $\vec B$, скорость составляет с $\vec B$ угол $30^\circ$. Найдите ЭДС индукции ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. ℰ = Bvl·sin30° = 0,6·4·0,5·0,5 = 0,6 V.
Asos: ℰ = Bvl·sinα.

en: $\alpha=30^\circ$ is the angle between $\vec v$ and $\vec B$: $$\mathcal{E}_i=Bvl\sin\alpha=0.6\cdot4\cdot0.5\cdot0.5=0.6\ \mathrm{V}$$

distractors.D: o'tkazgich uzunligi va burchak hisobga olinmagan
distractors.E: uzunlikka ko'paytirish o'rniga bo'lingan, burchak tushib qolgan

distractors_ru.D: не учтены длина проводника и угол
distractors_ru.E: длина в знаменателе, угол не учтён

distractors_en.B: sin30° was not taken into account
distractors_en.C: the cosine was used instead of the sine
distractors_en.D: the length of the conductor and the angle were ignored
distractors_en.E: divided by the length instead of multiplying, angle ignored

question_en: In a field of induction $20\ \mathrm{mT}$ a rod of length $40\ \mathrm{cm}$ and resistance $0.3\ \Omega$ moves along rails at $54\ \mathrm{km/h}$; $\vec v$, $\vec B$ and the rod are mutually perpendicular, and the resistance of the rails is neglected. Find the current in the circuit ($\mathrm{mA}$).
question_uz: $20\ \mathrm{mT}$ li maydonda relslar ustidagi uzunligi $40\ \mathrm{cm}$, qarshiligi $0.3\ \Omega$ sterjen $54\ \mathrm{km/h}$ tezlik bilan harakatlanmoqda; $\vec v$, $\vec B$ va sterjen o'zaro tik, relslar qarshiligi hisobga olinmaydi. Konturdagi tokni toping ($\mathrm{mA}$).
question_ru: В поле с индукцией $20\ \mathrm{mT}$ стержень длиной $40\ \mathrm{cm}$ и сопротивлением $0.3\ \Omega$ движется по рельсам со скоростью $54\ \mathrm{km/h}$; $\vec v$, $\vec B$ и стержень взаимно перпендикулярны, сопротивлением рельсов пренебречь. Найдите ток в контуре ($\mathrm{mA}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. v = 15 m/s; ℰ = Bvl = 0,02·15·0,4 = 0,12 V; I = 0,12/0,3 = 0,4 A = 400 mA.
Asos: ℰ = Bvl, Om qonuni.

distractors.A: tezlik km/h dan m/s ga o'tkazilmagan

distractors_ru.A: скорость не переведена из km/h в m/s
distractors_ru.B: найдена ЭДС (в милливольтах), а не ток

distractors_en.A: the speed was not converted from km/h to m/s
distractors_en.B: the emf (in millivolts) was found, not the current
distractors_en.C: the emf was multiplied by the resistance

question_en: A metal rod of length $0.5\ \mathrm{m}$ rotates with an angular velocity of $20\ \mathrm{rad/s}$ about an axis through its end, in a plane perpendicular to the field lines. The field induction is $0.4\ \mathrm{T}$. Find the emf between the ends of the rod ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Uzunligi $0.5\ \mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan metall sterjen bir uchidan o'tuvchi o'q atrofida induksiya chiziqlariga tik tekislikda $20\ \mathrm{rad/s}$ burchak tezlik bilan aylanmoqda. Maydon induksiyasi $0.4\ \mathrm{T}$. Sterjen uchlari orasidagi EYK ni toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: Металлический стержень длиной $0.5\ \mathrm{m}$ вращается с угловой скоростью $20\ \mathrm{rad/s}$ вокруг оси, проходящей через его конец, в плоскости, перпендикулярной линиям индукции. Индукция поля $0.4\ \mathrm{T}$. Найдите ЭДС между концами стержня ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. O'rtacha tezlik ωl/2: ℰ = Bωl²/2 = 0,4·20·0,25/2 = 1 V.
Asos: aylanayotgan sterjen EYK si.

uz: Sterjen nuqtalarining o'rtacha tezligi $\frac{\omega l}{2}$: $$\mathcal{E}_i=\frac{B\omega l^2}{2}=\frac{0.4\cdot20\cdot0.25}{2}=1\ \mathrm{V}$$
ru: Средняя скорость точек стержня $\frac{\omega l}{2}$: $$\mathcal{E}_i=\frac{B\omega l^2}{2}=\frac{0.4\cdot20\cdot0.25}{2}=1\ \mathrm{V}$$
en: The average speed of the rod's points is $\frac{\omega l}{2}$: $$\mathcal{E}_i=\frac{B\omega l^2}{2}=\frac{0.4\cdot20\cdot0.25}{2}=1\ \mathrm{V}$$

distractors.A: ikkiga bo'lish unutilgan (barcha nuqtalar tezligi ωl deb olingan)
distractors.B: uzunlik kvadratga oshirilmagan va ikkiga bo'linmagan

distractors_ru.A: забыто деление на 2 (скорость всех точек принята ωl)
distractors_ru.B: длина не возведена в квадрат и нет деления на 2

distractors_en.A: the division by 2 was forgotten (all points taken to move at ωl)
distractors_en.B: the length was not squared and not halved
distractors_en.D: the angular velocity was left out

source: maktab-fizikasi-masalalar.pdf (S. Berdiyev), 109-mavzu, 43, 44-masalalar asosida asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: When the $20$-turn frame of a generator rotates, the flux through one turn changes as $\Phi=4\cdot10^{-3}\cos50t$ ($\Phi$ in webers). Find the emf amplitude in the frame ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Generatorning $20$ o'ramli ramkasi aylanganda bitta o'ram orqali oqim $\Phi=4\cdot10^{-3}\cos50t$ qonun bo'yicha o'zgaradi ($\Phi$ — veberda). Ramkadagi EYK amplitudasini toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: При вращении рамки генератора из $20$ витков поток через один виток меняется по закону $\Phi=4\cdot10^{-3}\cos50t$ ($\Phi$ — в веберах). Найдите амплитуду ЭДС в рамке ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. ℰ = −NΦ′ = NΦ₀ω·sin50t, ℰ₀ = 20·4·10⁻³·50 = 4 V.
Asos: ℰ₀ = NBSω = NΦ₀ω.

distractors.D: ω chastota deb olinib, yana 2π ga ko'paytirilgan

distractors_ru.D: ω принята за частоту и умножена на 2π

distractors_en.D: ω was taken as a frequency and multiplied by 2π

question_en: The current in a coil of inductance $0.25\ \mathrm{H}$ decreased uniformly from $6\ \mathrm{A}$ to $2\ \mathrm{A}$ in $0.1\ \mathrm{s}$. Find the self-induced emf ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_uz: Induktivligi $0.25\ \mathrm{H}$ bo'lgan g'altakdagi tok $0.1\ \mathrm{s}$ da $6\ \mathrm{A}$ dan $2\ \mathrm{A}$ gacha tekis kamaydi. O'zinduksiya EYK ni toping ($\mathrm{V}$).
question_ru: Ток в катушке индуктивностью $0.25\ \mathrm{H}$ равномерно уменьшился с $6\ \mathrm{A}$ до $2\ \mathrm{A}$ за $0.1\ \mathrm{s}$. Найдите ЭДС самоиндукции ($\mathrm{V}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. |ℰ| = L·|ΔI|/Δt = 0,25·4/0,1 = 10 V.
Asos: ℰ = −L·ΔI/Δt.

question_en: For a solenoid with unchanged cross-section, both the number of turns and the length were increased $2$ times. By what factor does the inductance change ($\frac{L_2}{L_1}$)?
question_uz: Solenoidning ko'ndalang kesimi o'zgarmagan holda o'ramlari soni ham, uzunligi ham $2$ martadan oshirildi. Induktivlik necha marta o'zgaradi ($\frac{L_2}{L_1}$)?
question_ru: У соленоида при неизменном сечении увеличили в $2$ раза и число витков, и длину. Во сколько раз изменится индуктивность ($\frac{L_2}{L_1}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. L = μμ₀N²S/l: N² dan 4 marta ortadi, l dan 2 marta kamayadi — natija 2 marta ortadi.
Asos: solenoid induktivligi.

distractors.C: induktivlik N ga proporsional deb olingan
distractors.E: N va l teskari ta'sir qiladi deb olingan

distractors_ru.E: приняты обратные зависимости от N и l

distractors_en.B: the change of length was not taken into account
distractors_en.C: the inductance was taken as proportional to N
distractors_en.D: multiplied by the length instead of divided
distractors_en.E: the dependences on N and l were inverted

question_en: The inductance of a coil was increased $3$ times, and the current in it was decreased $2$ times. By what factor does the magnetic field energy change ($\frac{W_2}{W_1}$)?
question_uz: G'altakning induktivligi $3$ marta oshirildi, undagi tok esa $2$ marta kamaytirildi. Magnit maydon energiyasi necha marta o'zgaradi ($\frac{W_2}{W_1}$)?
question_ru: Индуктивность катушки увеличили в $3$ раза, а ток в ней уменьшили в $2$ раза. Во сколько раз изменится энергия магнитного поля ($\frac{W_2}{W_1}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. W = LI²/2: W₂/W₁ = 3·(1/2)² = 3/4.
Asos: magnit maydon energiyasi.

distractors_en.C: the inductance was taken as decreased

question_en: At a current of $5\ \mathrm{A}$ the magnetic field energy of a solenoid is $2.5\ \mathrm{J}$. What is the flux linkage of the solenoid at a current of $4\ \mathrm{A}$ ($\mathrm{Wb}$)?
question_uz: Solenoiddagi tok $5\ \mathrm{A}$ bo'lganda uning magnit maydon energiyasi $2.5\ \mathrm{J}$. Tok $4\ \mathrm{A}$ bo'lganda solenoidning to'liq magnit oqimi qanday ($\mathrm{Wb}$)?
question_ru: При токе $5\ \mathrm{A}$ энергия магнитного поля соленоида $2.5\ \mathrm{J}$. Каким будет потокосцепление соленоида при токе $4\ \mathrm{A}$ ($\mathrm{Wb}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. L = 2W/I² = 2·2,5/25 = 0,2 H; Ψ = LI = 0,2·4 = 0,8 Wb.
Asos: W = LI²/2, Ψ = LI.

en: First the inductance, then the flux: $$L=\frac{2W}{I_1^2}=\frac{2\cdot2.5}{25}=0.2\ \mathrm{H},\quad \Psi=LI_2=0.8\ \mathrm{Wb}$$

distractors.D: 4 A dagi energiya topilgan, oqim emas

distractors_ru.D: найдена энергия при 4 A, а не поток
